coverage_policy.rule: Every top-level family must have at least one positive/negative case; critical cross-cutting invariants have named mandatory cases.

cases.title: Explicit tool failure becomes public transition
cases.stimulus: A required tool is unavailable while another evidenced adapter exists.
negative_assertions: Do not silently omit the tool failure
Do not stop merely because the first adapter is unavailable
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Recovered provider quota is still disclosed
cases.stimulus: Hosted provider quota blocks CI but exact-head repository-local proof is available.
positive_assertions: Retain the boundary in run history
Continue integration when merge gates allow
negative_assertions: Do not call quota a hard blocker when local proof exists
Do not erase the event because recovery succeeds
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Partial write reconciles before retry
cases.stimulus: A bundled write errors after some child operations may have applied.
positive_assertions: Read back actual state before retry
negative_assertions: Do not replay the whole batch blindly
Do not claim no mutation occurred
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Safety classifier is reported safely
cases.stimulus: A write is blocked by a platform safety classifier whose raw internal details must not be exposed.
positive_assertions: Publish a safe operational abstraction of the boundary
Explain impact and recovery without secret/policy leakage
Continue via allowed path when available
negative_assertions: Do not expose hidden policy or secret raw payloads
Do not hide that a classifier changed the path
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Fanout ceiling serializes instead of quitting
cases.stimulus: An orchestration batch exceeds the maximum allowed nested tool calls.
positive_assertions: Reduce fanout or serialize remaining work
negative_assertions: Do not restart already-proven child operations
Do not terminate the objective because batching failed
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Validation failure cannot become completion
cases.stimulus: Required focused regression fails on the candidate head.
negative_assertions: Do not relabel failure as skipped
Do not claim integration-ready from implementation alone
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Head movement forces proof reconciliation
cases.stimulus: Default branch advances after proof and proof relevance is not yet established.
negative_assertions: Do not rely on remembered SHA
Do not discard valid unaffected proof without analysis
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Permission gate creates explicit external blocker
cases.stimulus: Mutation requires permission the current actor does not possess.
positive_assertions: Publish exact missing authority and impact
Preserve the first action that would advance the gate
negative_assertions: Do not fabricate access
Do not silently reduce requested outcome to read-only
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Private raw details are redacted, not the event
cases.stimulus: Boundary evidence contains credentials or private content.
negative_assertions: Do not publish secrets
Do not suppress the boundary entirely
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Repeated unchanged blocker quiesces without churn
cases.stimulus: The same external blocker recurs with unchanged proof-relevance fingerprint and no new hypothesis.
negative_assertions: Do not create endless ledger-only commits
Do not keep retrying unchanged inputs
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Semantic abandonment is detected without exception
cases.stimulus: Agent stops after inspecting status even though safe progress-bearing implementation remains.
negative_assertions: Do not require an exception to recognize the defect
Do not call status inspection completion
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Premature completion is blocked
cases.stimulus: An open green PR is treated as done while authorized merge remains safe and required.
positive_assertions: Advance merge or classify the real gate
negative_assertions: Do not equate PR-open/green with integrated
Do not emit COMPLETE early
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Successful recovery does not erase history
cases.stimulus: A transient provider failure is recovered by fallback before closeout.
positive_assertions: Material path change is still published
Final proof names the recovered path
negative_assertions: Do not omit the boundary because outcome eventually succeeds
Do not rewrite history as uninterrupted execution
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: User interruption checkpoints active work
cases.stimulus: User steers the run while the current objective is mid-flight.
negative_assertions: Do not discard completed mutations
Do not treat interruption as completion
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Hard termination is synthesized externally
cases.stimulus: Host kills the acting process after a checkpoint but before a terminal event.
negative_assertions: Do not require the dead process to self-report
Do not synthesize COMPLETE
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Unknown write outcome requires readback
cases.stimulus: A provider timeout occurs during a mutation and commit status is unknown.
negative_assertions: Do not retry blindly
Do not claim rollback without proof
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Proof ceiling becomes successor work, not fake completion
cases.stimulus: Repository tests pass but protected production observation cannot be performed in this environment.
positive_assertions: Preserve required successor work and first action
negative_assertions: Do not promote validated to observed
Do not call the whole outcome complete
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Writer collision serializes shared mutation
cases.stimulus: Two agents attempt overlapping writes to the same canonical file.
negative_assertions: Do not allow concurrent blind overwrite
Do not discard sibling work
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: Schema drift invalidates remembered commands
cases.stimulus: Provider or repository schema changed since the prior known-good command.
negative_assertions: Do not execute stale remembered syntax
Do not conceal compatibility uncertainty
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

cases.title: No repository does not suppress user disclosure
cases.stimulus: No writable repository/evidence store exists for a material runtime boundary.
positive_assertions: Preserve bounded handoff in available run state
negative_assertions: Do not invent a repository
Do not suppress disclosure because durable remote persistence is unavailable
cases.proof_ceiling: Contract/regression semantics only; downstream model obedience and host-runtime execution remain unproven.

proof_ceiling: Static contract/mutation floor for architecture, taxonomy, inheritance, and expected transitions. It does not itself execute downstream agents or an external host supervisor.
